name: HoverCard
description: A hover card: `content` and a trigger child, or the parts `Root`, `Trigger` and `Popup` from Base UI's preview card.
signature: ({ content, children, size, side, align, delay, closeDelay, open, onOpenChange }: HoverCardProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment along that side. Default centre.

props.name: children
props.description: The element that opens the card on hover and keyboard focus, normally a link. It must forward its ref and props.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before closing once the pointer leaves. Default 150.

props.name: content
props.description: The card's content: a summary of what the trigger points to. Never the only way to reach an action.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes, including keyboard dismissal and outside interaction.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the trigger; collision handling may choose another. Default bottom.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.
